method: Match authored pin targets/guide links by part ID; for multi-guide bars, infer each guide passage axis from the longest edges of its enabled non-trigger wall polygons in world XY. Count per asset occurrence, not campaign or deduplicated layouts.
limits: Authored links do not establish active sensor/body contact or that every guide is necessary.
Parallel wall axes constrain the geometric passage but do not certify a motion route or the original slide resolver.
Do not map these asset IDs to screenshots, compare difficulty, or copy colliders into a Designer draft.
Only supported straight/L/U compact paths are generated. Source custom outlines are not automatically classified as L/U or imported.
